## Kudzu, The Everblight (CR 24)

**XP** 1,230,000  
 NE Colossal plant (kaiju)  
 **Init** +9; **Senses** darkvision 600 ft., low-light vision; Perception +30; **Aura** calming fragrance (1 mile, DC 36)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 37, touch 8, flat-footed 31 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +29 natural, -8 size)  
 **hp** 665 (38d8+494); fast healing 30  
 **Fort** +35, **Ref** +19, **Will** +17  
 **Defensive Abilities** ferocity, recovery; **DR** 20/epic; **Immune** ability damage, ability drain, death effects, disease, energy drain, fear, plant traits; **Resist** acid 30, cold 30, electricity 30, fire 30, negative energy 30, sonic 30; **SR** 35  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 70 ft., climb 30 ft.  
 **Melee** 10 vines +40 (6d8+19 plus grab and bleed/17-20)  
 **Space** 80 ft.; **Reach** 100 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** bleed (2d6), constrict (6d8+28), feed, hurl foes  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 38th; concentration +43)  

  At will—charm monster (DC 18), detect thoughts (DC 17), suggestion (DC 18)  
 3/day—quickened glitterdust (DC 17), hold monster (DC 20)  
 1/day—commune with nature, mind fog, wall of thorns  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 48, **Dex** 21, **Con** 34, **Int** 13, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 21  
 **Base Atk** +28; **CMB** +55 (+59 disarm, grapple, trip); **CMD** 70 (72 vs. disarm; can’t be tripped)  
 **Feats** Alertness, Combat Expertise, Critical Focus, Deceitful, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Greater Disarm, Greater Trip, Improved Initiative, [Deft Maneuvers](../../rules/feats/deft-maneuvers.md), Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Quicken Spell-Like Ability (glitterdust), Spring Attack, Tripping Strike, Vital Strike, Whirlwind Attack, [Weapon Focus (vine)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), [Great Fortitude](../../rules/feats/great-fortitude.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge and Mobility are one feat, Dodgility; Improved Disarm, Improved Trip are covered by Deft Maneuvers; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (vine), Toughness, Great Fortitude.*  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +5 (+21 jumping), Bluff +29, Climb +27, Disguise +29, Knowledge (nature) +21, Perception +30, Sense Motive +21, Stealth +12  
 **Languages** Aklo, Common, Elven, Sylvan (can’t speak)  
 **SQ** massive  

**Special Abilities**

 **Calming Fragrance (Su)** A supernaturally sweet perfume that calms the nerves and blunts aggression constantly surrounds Kudzu to a radius of 1 mile. Any creature in this area of effect must make a DC 36 Will save at the start of its turn to avoid falling under the effects of calm emotions for 1 round. This is a mind-affecting effect. The save DC is Charisma-based, and includes a +2 racial bonus.  

 **Feed (Ex)** Kudzu’s roots can feed on a helpless or willing target. At the end of each minute of feeding, the victim takes 1d3 points of both Constitution and Intelligence drain, and Kudzu gains another vine attack which remains for 1 hour per Hit Die the victim has.
